program: Georgia Medicaid / PeachCare for Kids - Dental Services (fee-for-service)
document_title: Part II Policies and Procedures for Dental Services - Appendix B Maximum Allowable Charges (manual edition 'Dental Services Q2 - April 2026')
notes: ACCESS CAVEAT: mmis.georgia.gov times out from this machine (and WebFetch is refused), so the official PDF was downloaded as the Wayback Machine capture of its official URL dated 2026-06-09 (http://web.archive.org/web/20260609235102id_/<source_url>). It is the newest Dental Services manual found in the archive; quarterly July 2026 / October 2026 editions may exist on GAMMIS but could not be seen - DOUBT, re-check from a US connection. Effective date = edition quarter (April 2026); the CMS-approved SPA GA-25-0005 raised most of these codes by 2.5% effective 2025-07-01 and states all rates are published in this manual. Single 'Max Allow' column; COS indicator 'Health Check & Adults' for most codes (population 'all'); D1120 is 'Health Check Only' (children under 21); D4342 and D4910 are 'Pregnant Women Only'. Multiple rows in Appendix B (value recorded under 'all' = permanent tooth / two-or-more-teeth / first tooth row): D2140 primary 67.56 (Health Check Only) vs permanent 73.51; D2150 primary 87.03 (Health Check Only) vs permanent 95.05; D2392 primary 108.45 vs permanent 113.51; D2393 primary 133.67 vs permanent 160.17; D2394 primary 147.04 vs permanent 176.18; D3310 primary 79.58 vs permanent 389.34; D5211 single tooth 283.56 vs two or more 583.48; D5212 single tooth 283.56 vs two or more 677.89; D7140 first tooth 82.80, each additional 79.19. Most Georgia Medicaid/PeachCare members are in CMOs whose dental vendors may pay differently; these are the state FFS maximum allowable charges.
notes_2024: Edition 'Dental Services Q4-October 2024' (file stamped 2024-10-22), Appendix B Maximum Allowable Charges, downloaded via Wayback capture of the official URL dated 2025-01-14. The April 2024 v2 edition that was current on 2024-07-01 is not archived (Wayback shows 404). The October 2024 edition is used as the closest proxy: it already states 'Effective July 1, 2024, all procedure codes indicated in Appendix B are available to Members regardless of age', Georgia dental rate changes are made on July 1 (state fiscal year), and for most codes its fees are about 2.5% below the April 2026 fees, matching SPA GA-25-0005 effective 2025-07-01 (exception: D9223 115.19 -> 142.51; D2140/D2150 permanent unchanged). So these fees are very probably the ones in force on 2024-07-01, but no document dated on or before 2024-07-01 was seen - small DOUBT. Same multi-row convention: D2140 primary 65.91 vs permanent 73.51; D2150 primary 84.91 vs permanent 95.05; D2392 primary 105.80 vs permanent 110.74; D2393 primary 130.41 vs permanent 156.26; D2394 primary 143.45 vs permanent 171.88; D3310 primary 77.64 vs permanent 379.84; D5211 single 276.64 vs two or more 569.25; D5212 single 276.64 vs two or more 661.36; D7140 first 80.78, each additional 77.26.
